hotspot_guide_gemini_key_budgets_usd.label: Monthly budget per Gemini key (USD)
hotspot_guide_gemini_key_budgets_usd.help: Optional. Same order as the extra Gemini keys, then the key above, comma separated, e.g. 95,95,0; 0 or blank means no budget. What actually switches keys is Google refusing: 402 once a prepaid balance runs out, or 429 at a monthly spending cap if one is set.

hotspot_guide_gemini_api_keys_extra.label: Extra Gemini keys (Google AI Ultra accounts)
hotspot_guide_gemini_api_keys_extra.help: Several allowed, separated by commas or new lines. These keys (each Ultra account's monthly Google Cloud credit) are used up in order first; the key above only takes over once Google refuses all of them.

panel.title: Gemini key pool
panel.intro: Used in order. A key Google refuses for credit or spending cap rests and is tried again after at most 12 hours. This month's spend is the site's estimate; the AI Studio billing page shows the real balance.
panel.error: Could not read the key pool
panel.single: There is only one Gemini key. Add the Ultra accounts' keys under Extra Gemini keys above and each one will be listed here.
